findings.desc: concept-cleanup: CHK-003 deleted session.ts listActiveWorktrees(), but packages/main/src/tasks/gitroot-cwd-contract-smoke.ts:166-168 still names it in the allowlist comment ("listActiveWorktrees / branch probe: an inline-arg bare-root git probe used to enumerate worktrees / infer the active story before a storyId is in scope") as the rationale for exempting the whole handlers/session.ts file. The function no longer exists in session.ts; the exemption is still valid only because of the unrelated branch-probe execSync calls that remain (lines 104/161/165), so the comment now misattributes its own justification to a deleted symbol and will mislead a future reader into searching for listActiveWorktrees in session.ts.

quality-cleanup: packages/main/src/handlers/validation-plan.ts:678 `const { store, root } = ctx;` — `store` is destructured but never read anywhere in createValidationPlanHandlers after the CHK-003 refactor moved workspace resolution into `resolveStoryWorkspace(ctx, ...)`. Confirmed by diffing `tsc --noUnusedLocals -p packages/main` between main and this branch: this TS6133 hit is new on this branch (3 other unused-declaration hits in the same run are pre-existing on main, this one is not). Dead variable left behind by the extraction; delete it from the destructure.

quality-cleanup: packages/main/src/core/story-workspace.ts:96 `StoryWorkspace.storyDir` is computed (via `store.storyDirPath(storyId)`) but never read by any of the four migrated call sites (session.ts, story-query.ts, validation-plan.ts, local-assurance-story-projection.ts) and never asserted in single-owner-extraction-smoke.ts (grep for `workspace.storyDir` across handlers + smoke returns zero hits, vs. every other field on the interface having at least one production consumer or a direct smoke assertion). It is dead weight on an already-large 11-field return shape that this same review was asked to check for size/readability; either wire a consumer or drop the field.
